sourceConfidence.notice: Yunnan data was extracted from a published image of the official provincial suitable-flight map rather than original GIS data. Boundaries are approximate and may contain extraction or positional inaccuracies. Check the current official map before flying.

source.authority: Published image of the Yunnan provincial suitable-flight map, vectorized by UAV Companion (not original GIS data)

extraction.method: colour segmentation of the published map image, owner purple/orange corrections for label and artefact areas, Web Mercator georeferencing from visible city control points, vectorization
caveats: Geometry is extracted from a rendered official-map image, not original GIS vectors.
Purple owner annotations restore areas obscured by labels; orange owner annotations remain excluded.
Calibration is based on visible city markers and a Web Mercator model; local boundary error can exceed control-point residuals.
extraction.geojsonNote: Approximate image-derived Yunnan fly-zone geometry (corrected v2, 14 polygons); purple owner annotations restored as flyable; orange annotations kept no-fly/unknown. Not suitable for precise boundary decisions.
